transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Well, doctor, what brings me in today is that... my head just feels cloudy lately. I'll be sitting there staring at a board packet or an email from a vendor, and I just can't seem to make a decision. Even simple things that I used to handle fast, without a second thought, are suddenly taking me forever to figure out.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless lately?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel depressed or hopeless. It's more just... this fog in my head, like I said. I'm just having a hard time getting things done, but my mood itself isn't particularly down.
Have you been using any substances, like alcohol, marijuana, or anything else, that might be affecting your thinking or decision-making?
No, I don't use anything like that. I might have a glass of wine at dinner every now and then, but that's about it. Nothing else.
Have you been feeling more anxious, worried, or overwhelmed lately, even if just mildly, that might be making it harder for you to focus or make decisions?

No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious or worried. I don't feel overwhelmed in that way. It's really just the cloudiness... I'm just not as sharp as I need to be, but I'm not sitting there worrying about it or feeling nervous. Just having trouble getting the work done.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory lately, like forgetting things more often than usual or struggling to recall information?

No, my memory is fine. I haven't been forgetting things or anything like that. It's just the focus, really... just that cloudy feeling when I try to concentrate on my work. But remembering things isn't an issue.
How long have you been feeling this way with the cloudiness and difficulty concentrating on your work?

It's been about two weeks now. It all started when my husband retired and was suddenly just... home all day. At first, I had this really sharp change where I felt full of energy and confidence, but then it turned into this low, cloudy feeling that I just can't shake.

Can you tell me more about that period when you felt full of energy and confidence? Did you notice any other changes during that time, like needing less sleep, talking more than usual, or taking on more tasks?

I'm not really sure about the sleep or the talking, but as far as taking on more tasks, yes, definitely. It felt like... well, I just had this push in my body like I had to keep moving. I was constantly calling people, making lists, and walking the properties even after I should have gone home for the day. I just couldn't seem to stop working and sit still.

During that time when you felt full of energy and confidence, did you also feel unusually happy or elevated, or maybe more irritable than usual, for most of the day, nearly every day for at least four or five days in a row?

Well, yes, I'd say... it was a bit of both. There were days during that stretch where I felt almost too bright and bold. Like at the association meetings, I caught myself just talking right over people because I was so fired up. But then I'd go home and just snap at my husband over some small, silly thing. So yeah, I definitely felt that way for a good number of days in a row.
